description: The core apps the platform provides, as CONTRACTS. Each entry names a <systemKey>.contract.json beside this file: what the app offers, so that a cross-app reference to it can be validated and an agent can discover it instead of re-modelling it. The full definitions are not here — a contract states what an app offers, not how it is built.

conventions.contracts: Each entry must exist as core/<systemKey>.contract.json. Generated from the private definition by tools/CoreContracts in the platform repository; never hand-edited.
